authority: apostila-cga-2026; reversal of a regression I introduced in amendment 58
method: the form probed in isolation and in a sentence; neither matches
reason: Amendment 58 added `Resolução CVM 175/22` and the form never fires. Probed both ways: `Resolução CVM 175` matches on its own, `Resolução CVM 175/22` matches NOTHING — not even its own three-token prefix — because the slash sits between two protected number spans and something in the candidate filter refuses the whole region. I can state the symptom precisely and cannot trace it to the line without more budget than I have, and guessing at the engine is how the two regressions earlier tonight were made. So this reverses my change rather than building on an untraced cause: the heading returns to `partial`, which is where it was before I touched it, and the registry stops carrying a form that does nothing. The underlying matcher behaviour is a real, reproducible finding and is recorded here rather than left in the tree as a dead entry.

operations.why: Never matches. A form that cannot fire is registry noise, and leaving it would also leave the false impression that the citation-with-year spelling is handled.
